# Sites@Duke Express

> A Duke-hosted WordPress platform providing website creation and management tools with integrated authentication, content editing, and analytics capabilities.

Sites@Duke Express is the university's official website hosting solution built on WordPress, offering faculty, staff, and students an easy way to create and maintain web presence with Duke NetID authentication and enterprise features like Elementor Pro for design and Matomo for analytics.

## Key Topics

- WordPress
- Duke NetID
- Shibboleth Authentication
- Elementor Pro
- Block Editor
- Gutenberg
- Matomo Analytics
- Sites@Duke Express
- Product Releases
- Plugins
- Themes
- Content Management
- Web Hosting
- Duke University

- [Log In](https://sites.duke.edu/wp-login.php): Login page for Sites@Duke Express using Duke NetID and Shibboleth authentication
